commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
90+1' That's a clear yellow card. Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book.
90+1' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
88' What a chance that is! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
87' Gregor Kobel pulls off a great save to deny Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
86' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

86' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
84' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) replaces Marco Reus.
79' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
79' Here comes a substitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Exequiel Palacios.
77' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
76' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
74' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' The attendance for today's match is 30210.

74' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto a ball from Florian Wirtz and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
73' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
72' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.

68' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
68' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' The current number of corner kicks is 12:1.
66' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared.
64' Today's match ends for Jamie Bynoe-Gittens who will be replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
64' Here is a change. Nico Schlotterbeck is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Antonios Papadopoulos (Dortmund).
64' That's the end of the game for Jonas Hofmann, who is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
63' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tested Gregor Kobel with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
62' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen), but Gregor Kobel is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
62' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the defence.

61' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
58' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a chip pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel is quickest to intercept the ball.
57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

56' The ball is cleared after Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

52' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
52' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
52' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
51' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
48' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
48' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
48' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
48' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
47' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
45+3' The goal by Bayer Leverkusen won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+2' Jeremie Frimpong plays a neat ball into the path of Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes room for a shot and sends it towards the top right corner, ricocheting in off the post! 1:1.
45+1' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' A lofted cross from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.

43' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
40' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

38' Chance! Florian Wirtz sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
38' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Gregor Kobel to dive and make a save.
30' Emre Can (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Daniel Siebert signals a set piece.
29' Lukas Hradecky displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marco Reus (Dortmund) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

27' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
27' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
26' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner.
24' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
21' That was close. Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

20' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
19' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short.
18' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
16' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
14' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
11' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

11' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Jonas Hofmann with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
9' Daniel Siebert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Emre Can (Dortmund) and blew his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick.
8' Marco Reus (Dortmund) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Julian Brandt.
7' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Gregor Kobel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
5' 0 - 1 Niclas Fullkrug provides Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
4' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off his line to gather the ball.
